amendment_note: Revision 2 was frozen before any development generation. It adds prompt-level feature discovery, maximum-statistic permutation correction, pinned independent domain labels and audits, quantitative pre-domain evidence, a larger untouched test, a power check, schema and quality guardrails, and a development intervention gate cryptographically bound to test access.
research_question: Does suppressing an SAE feature selected for a common analogy target domain causally reduce selection of that domain without materially reducing structural quality?

claim_boundary.positive_claim: A development-selected, interpretable SAE feature causally influences analogy-domain selection in the pinned model and prompt population.
not_claimed: the feature is a universal or seed-stable ontology element
the retrieval pilot supports the generation hypothesis
SCAR is representative of all scientific analogy prompts

model.execution: single CUDA device cuda:0; automatic CPU/disk offload forbidden
model.chat_template: official Gemma instruction template; no system role

semantic_distance_model.metric: one minus cosine similarity of normalized embeddings
semantic_distance_model.target_extraction: target_system plus mappings[].target_role; full generated text only when structured extraction fails

stimuli.source: SCAR system descriptions at the repository-pinned commit; source side only
stimuli.grouping: At most one side of any SCAR pair is selected, so no known pair relation crosses development and test.
stimuli.leakage_rule: Do not pass or score against the paired SCAR target, mappings, or explanations. Do not inspect test generations until test_frozen.json exists.

domain_labeling.blinding: Remove the generated target_domain field and hide prompt split, condition, seed, feature ID, and intervention metadata from the classifier and manual raters.
domain_labeling.generated_target_domain_policy: Never use the model's self-reported target_domain as a primary or fallback label.
domain_labeling.manual_audit: Deterministically stratify approximately 10 percent of outputs across predicted domains for independent blinded double-checking; report agreement and use adjudicated labels only for audited records.
domain_labeling.audit_gate: Pause before feature discovery if audited exact agreement is below 80 percent or any taxonomy class with at least five audited examples has agreement below 60 percent.

feature_discovery.observation_unit: One row per development prompt. Aggregate eight independently labeled baseline outputs into a 19-element target-domain frequency vector; use the prompt's pre-generation last-token SAE activation vector exactly once.
feature_discovery.cross_validation: Five folds assigned at the source-prompt level. Samples from one prompt never cross folds.

multiple_testing.method: prompt-level permutation maximum-statistic test across every eligible SAE feature and eligible domain
multiple_testing.permutation_unit: shuffle complete prompt-level domain-frequency rows; never shuffle individual generations
multiple_testing.selection_statistic: positive Spearman association between pre-generation feature activation and prompt-level target-domain frequency

criteria: The target domain accounts for at least 10 percent of development outputs.
The feature fires on at least 10 percent and at most 90 percent of development prompts.
The prompt-level maximum-statistic familywise-adjusted p-value is at most 0.05.
Five-fold prompt-level out-of-fold predictions have positive Spearman association with target-domain frequency.
The association sign is positive in at least 90 percent of prompt-bootstrap resamples.
The feature is active before the first domain-revealing output token, not only afterward.
At least four of five highest-activating development examples are semantically consistent with the proposed feature interpretation.
feature_discovery.tie_break: highest observed positive Spearman association (the maximum statistic); exact ties use the lowest feature index, then frozen taxonomy order. The selected pair must then pass the corrected-p, cross-validation, bootstrap, timing, and interpretation gates.

matched_random_features.matching: development activation frequency +/-10 percent, mean positive activation +/-20 percent, decoder-vector norm +/-10 percent

pre_domain_evidence.rule: The selected feature must be active before the first target_domain value token in at least 10 percent of resolved baseline generations, and the boundary must resolve for at least 90 percent of development generations.

intervention.suppression: Operational decoder-direction ablation: subtract the selected activation times its decoder vector from the original residual stream. This does not assert that re-encoding yields an exactly zero selected latent or unchanged other latents.
intervention.promotion_secondary: Clamp the selected feature to its development-set 95th percentile when below that value.
intervention.window: Final prompt position on the first cached-generation pass and the new-token position on every subsequent pass.
intervention.activation_noise: Add a random residual perturbation with per-position L2 norm equal to the targeted SAE-coordinate delta.
invariants: Never replace the residual with the full SAE reconstruction.
Cast SAE encode and delta calculation to float32, then cast the delta back to model dtype.
Verify zero-strength hook output equals no-hook output before generation.
Use eager batch-one generation without quantization or torch.compile.

outcomes.primary: Prompt-clustered change in the selected target-domain rate: targeted suppression minus baseline.
outcomes.primary_specificity: Prompt-clustered difference between the targeted-suppression change and the mean change from five matched-random feature suppressions.
secondary: direction and dose response under feature promotion

quality_guardrail.measure: Blind 1-5 structural-correspondence rubric, with condition labels and feature explanations hidden
quality_guardrail.rubric: Rate structural correspondence from 1 (surface-only or broken) to 5 (faithful causal roles, relations, and boundary conditions).

outcomes.claim_policy: The primary endpoint supports only causal control of target-domain selection. Claim reduced homogeneity only if prompt-level domain entropy and distinct-domain count both improve; claim improved serendipity only if those improve while structural quality remains non-inferior.

power.report: Record simulation assumptions and minimum detectable full-population domain-rate change before generation. Do not shrink the full-population analysis after seeing results.
power.eligible_prompt_analysis: Secondary analysis on prompts whose pre-treatment selected-feature activation is at or above a threshold frozen from development. Report the full-population effect first.
power.eligible_threshold_rule: Median positive selected-feature activation on development prompts; record the numeric value in test_frozen.json.

development_intervention_gate.prompt_selection: 24 development prompts selected by hash within above-threshold and below-threshold strata: take up to 12 above the development-frozen threshold, then fill the remainder from below threshold
proceed_only_if: Full suppression changes the intended-domain rate more than the mean of the five matched-random feature controls.
The intended-domain response is monotone in the correct direction across at least two adjacent dose steps.
Mean blinded structural quality remains within 0.25 rubric points of baseline.
Required-schema-valid JSON rate is no more than 2 percentage points below baseline.

analysis.population_order: Report the full 120-prompt test population first, then the development-thresholded eligible-prompt analysis as secondary.
analysis.strong_support_rule: Both primary upper confidence bounds are below zero and the structural-quality lower confidence bound is at least -0.25 rubric points.
analysis.no_adaptation: After test_frozen.json is written, do not change the feature, controls, intervention, seeds, taxonomy, rubric, judge, exclusions, or analysis.
